title: Chapfallen
html_source: Having the lower jaw hanging loosely; cast down in spirit; depressed

anchor.prefix:
now, Martin Cunningham said. 

1932#103

 John Henry Menton jerked his head down in acknowledgment. 

 — Thank you, he said shortly. 

 They walked on towards the gates. Mr Bloom,
anchor.suffix:
, drew behind a few paces so as not to overhear. Martin laying down the law. Martin could wind a sappyhead like that round his little finger, without his seeing it. 

 Oyster eyes.
